solution_summary: Libertad Soluciones de Vida built this solution on Azure Synapse Analytics, Power BI, Dynamics 365. Merino points out that from the beginning, the goal was to crystallize strategic alliances in more effective financial services, which consolidate the integration of the systems with each other. Azure Synapse Analytics models and analyzes enterprise data for reporting, AI, and decision support. Power BI publishes dashboards and self-service analytics to business users. Dynamics 365 provides the core business application experience for service, sales, or operations workflows. By delineating a strategic technology plan that consisted of moving its customer database to Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Azure Synapse Analytics, assembling processes and migrating to Microsoft Azure, Sociedad Financiera Credit services that previously took 48 hours can now be provided in 30 minutes.
